entities.name: Dissension
entities.description: The third and final set of the Ravnica block, released May 2006, accompanied by a novel by Cory Herndon.

entities.name: Kos
entities.description: A dead man who still has a job to do and publicly arrests Szadek.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Dimir figure exposed along with House Dimir when Kos arrests him publicly.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: Ravnican guild exposed to the public through Szadek's arrest.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The spell binding the guilds, finally broken in this set's story.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where the guilds fight.

events.summary: Guilds fight each other and monsters ravage Ravnica, revealing that the chaos was calculated.
events.quote: Guild fights guild and horrifying monsters ravage the city, destroying all who stand in their way.

events.summary: Kos publicly arrests Szadek, finally breaking the Guildpact's spell and exposing House Dimir.
events.quote: The Guildpact's spell is finally broken when he publicly arrests Szadek , exposing him and House Dimir to the public.
